# Digital twin run — Baseline (no interventions)

*Model: `TWIN-BASE-10B` v1.0 (2026-07) — Archetype IDN — $10B NPR, single-instance Epic on AWS, Snowflake EDW, Databricks lakehouse. Horizon 36 months. Generated by `twin.py`; do not hand-edit.*

## Financial impact

- Net revenue captured: $10.06B/yr on expected net $10.06B
- Leakage: denials $237.0M, bad debt $199.1M, underpayment $45.3M, charge capture $75.4M
- Operating cost: $273.5M/yr (2.72% cost to collect)
- Net AR days: 49.8 | workforce: 2,510 FTE
